chunks: And what will make you know what that is?
ai.seo_question: What does 'Ma Hiyyah' refer to in Surah Al-Qari'ah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question (istifham for emphasis) underscores the overwhelming magnitude of the Day of Judgment, which surpasses human comprehension. It serves as a powerful introduction to Surah Al-Qari'ah, highlighting the suddenness and terror of the event to awaken the heedless. This verse reflects the Shia emphasis on the awe-inspiring nature of the Hereafter as a motivator for spiritual preparation.
